The '''Droid Equality Foundation''' was a large and powerful [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Droid rights/Legends|rights]] organization. Publicly, the Foundation aimed to emancipate droids and grant them the same rights as [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings, viewing [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolts]] as a symbol of droid oppression. However, in reality, the Foundation wanted to turn public opinion [[Anti-droid sentiment/Legends|against]] droids, and it increased fear and suspicion of droids by highlighting droid rebellions. At some point after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Human replica droid|replica droid]] [[Jolor Oron]] became the leader of the Droid Equality Foundation, and he planned to use the organization to destroy all of the droids in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
